Add vector control interventions to an OpenMalaria scenario

Source: R/xml_export.R
add_OM_GVI.Rd

Writes the generic vector interventions from get_OM_GVI_snippet into an openMalariaUtilities baseList. When the effects of an intervention share the same decay (e.g. no insecticide decay, or the same insecticide decay for all effects), they are written as one component named after the intervention, as in ITNcascades; otherwise as one component per effect (<name>-deterrency, <name>-preprandialKillingEffect, <name>-postprandialKillingEffect), as openMalariaUtilities::defineVectorControl() does. The component ids are printed: when there are several per intervention, they must be deployed together, to the same people (deploy_OM_vector_control). Dummy-host interventions have no pre-prandial component (its value is written as 0).

Requires the openMalariaUtilities package (uses its internal functions .defineInterventionsHeader() and .xmlAddList()).

Usage

add_OM_GVI(baseList, gvi, merge = TRUE, append = TRUE)

Arguments

baseList

openMalariaUtilities baseList (the human interventions section is created if needed).

gvi

Output of get_OM_GVI_snippet (several can be combined with c()).

merge

Logical (default TRUE): write one component when the three decays are identical.

append

Logical (default TRUE): append to the existing interventions.

Value

The updated baseList.

See also

get_OM_GVI_snippet

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gvi = c(get_OM_GVI_snippet(itn, om_ento, "ITN"),
        get_OM_GVI_snippet(irs, om_ento, "IRS"))
baseList = add_OM_GVI(baseList, gvi)
} # }
